prompt:
Make a NEW KFB soft claymation ink blob character sheet, The Estate Committee. The original reference PNGs guide the intact charcoal-plum goo anatomy, expressive filled sculpted eyelids, cream white sclera, distinct red iris and black pupil, and miniature prop modeling. Exactly six independent footless complete upright ink blobs in a 3-column by 2-row horizontal 1536×1024 true transparent PNG. Equal substantial scale. All props held or attached to their own body, all detached droplets inside generous gutters and canvas margins. No stage, floor, scenery, backdrop color, panel borders, text, labels or logos. Smooth softly satin clay with larger sparse hand-shaped marks, quiet cloth folds and clean smooth glass or glossy material. Avoid dense stipple, grit and crust. Keep organic thick rounded goo shapes and whole ink silhouette dominant, with minimal distinct costume or thematic prop. Teeth sit behind lips. Wide range of eyes, body attitudes and mouth shapes. Style and palette: Soft ink-blue, muted plum and cream, compact formal wear and quiet florist accents. The role cast in row-major order:
1. Female-read wreath maker. upright comma, brisk gaze and closed pursed lips. One compact cue: small oval wreath with extra ribbon rolled in one goo hand.
2. Male-read heir with a small inheritance. broad low pear, raised brows and reluctant smile. One compact cue: tiny sealed parcel held close in both hands.
3. Female-read speaker keeping notes out of the wind. tall tilted blob, intent narrowed eyes and tightly drawn mouth. One compact cue: three large cards with one edge curled upward.
4. Male-read deliberate obituary editor. square low blob, solemn eyes and small crooked frown. One compact cue: folded blank obituary proof with large pencil.
5. Male-read keeper of a slightly confusing will. rounded high teardrop, doubtful sideways gaze. One compact cue: rolled cream folio tied with a blunt wax seal.
6. Male-read quiet keepsake bearer. wide scalloped body, soft lids and warm small smile. One compact cue: tiny portrait locket held open at belly with a simple abstract silhouette.
Six distinct readable stand-alone figures, original archetypal props, very clear alpha gutters. No copied reference costume, wings or eyepatches.
